text:
sophia: flagging a small but repeating pattern: inbound leads from the webinar form sometimes don't get assigned for >20m. SLA is 15m. saw 12 hits in the last 3 hours.

michael: can you share 1-2 examples and whether enrichment ran?

sophia: example ids: 12001,12009. enrichment shows as completed after 2m, but HubSpot owner is still empty. HubSpot->SF mapping looks fine in the logs.

tara: quick theory: our enrichment lambda writes a full contact patch and may be clearing owner if payload omits the field. easy fix: enrichment should never send null for owner. i'll patch to strip owner key if null.

michael: also, add a HS workflow fallback: if Owner empty after 10m -> assign to `inbound-webinar-fallback` using round-robin, and create SF lead with temporary owner tag. Workflow snippet: ```Delay 10 minutes -> If Contact property Owner is unknown -> Set Owner = {{round_robin::inbound-webinar}} -> Create Task: "Assign owner (fallback)"```

sales-ops: please CC sales-leads@redwood.com when fallback runs. want a morning digest for now.

data-bot: quick TTA numbers (last 24h): median=12m, 95th=84m. filtering to webinar leads only: median=18m, 95th=102m. posting csv to #analytics in 10m.

tara: deploying enrichment guard now (small patch). will add unit test to ensure owner field is preserved. PR #588.

sre: suggest adding logs/metric: enrichment.owner_write_skipped=true/false and webhook.retry_count to help triage race conditions. also create an alert: page on >5 webinar leads unassigned >15m in 30m window.

michael: agreed. i'll enable the HS workflow in staging and run smoke. tara, please coordinate cutover.

sophia: staging smoke looks good. after enabling workflow in prod, monitored a 1h sample: webinar median TTA dropped to 6m, 95th to 24m. keeping digest for sales-ops.

tara: merged PR after green CI. added integration test that simulates concurrent enrichment + owner sync. also added safe-merge behaviour when writing HS contact patches.

sales-ops: thanks. i'll send a short note to SDRs: "If you see missing owner after enrichment, paste lead id here and we'll investigate."

michael: next steps: 1) add webhook exponential backoff on 5xx, 2) run a 48h audit of assignment causes, 3) include this scenario in runbook for inbound routing. assigning tickets.

sophia: closing loop for now 1: mitigation in prod + monitoring + ticket to harden. if anyone sees additional stray ids, drop them here. :thumbsup:
